page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage options. For network connectivity, the ecs.g7nex.8xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication for distributed systems and external services. It does not feature any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density make this instance suitable for workloads requiring predictable, sustained performance without the overhead of specialized hardware. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and 40 Gbps network baseline position the instance well for general-purpose enterprise workloads, including web serving, application servers, medium-sized databases, and continuous integration pipelines.
